Skills applied: antislop-human, antislop-layoutmobile, ui-ux-pro-max, then vercel:verification. Existing brand direction was retained. A focused focus-obscuration search returned relevant web guidance; the chart search did not return a verified match and was not used to prescribe a chart redesign.

Normal muted text on white measured 5.96:1; the observed focus outline color on white measured 7.85:1. These token calculations supplement rendered axe scans, not replace them. For the audit, the W3C large-text definition takes precedence over the skill’s simplified 18px rule. The project’s 44px comfort goal is stronger than WCAG’s AA minimum with exceptions. Reflow permits some two-dimensional data tables to scroll.

Recommended fixes and before / after

Start with F1–F4, then address F5–F7. F8–F9 are optional improvements for a later release. Every “after” below is a schematic proposal, not a rendered implementation. The actual findings remain open under the established audit-first workflow.

F1 · HIGH · UNIMPLEMENTED

Restore native list semantics in game details

[Verified] Open dialog at 390/1440px: axe reports two list nodes and ten disallowed-role nodes. A list item is being used as a button.

Source at candidate 3058478: explore-game-detail-modal.tsx:66–82

Before

<ul>
  <li role="button" tabIndex={0}>…</li>
</ul>

Proposed after

<ul>
  <li><button type="button">…</button></li>
</ul>

Implementation: Keep li as the list item. Put an actual button inside it; move click styling and labels to the button. Native Enter/Space replaces the custom keyboard handler.

Completion evidence: Axe on the open dialog at both widths; recent-game drill, Back, Tab containment, Escape and opener-focus restoration.

F2 · MEDIUM · UNIMPLEMENTED

Return focus after dismissing the page finder

[Verified] Root and independent checks: Find a page → input → Escape leaves document.activeElement at BODY, at both phone and desktop widths.

Source at candidate 3058478: page-search-button.tsx:5; command-palette-mount.tsx:54; command-palette.tsx:43

Before

Find a page → search input → BODY

Proposed after

Find a page → search input → Find a page

Implementation: Capture the invoking element before opening. Restore it on dismissal if still connected. Selecting a destination must preserve navigation focus instead of returning to the old page.

Completion evidence: First lazy load and subsequent openings; footer button and Ctrl/Cmd+K; Escape, outside dismissal and destination selection; no focus theft on navigation.

F3 · MEDIUM · UNIMPLEMENTED

Distinguish pending calendar counts from real zeroes

[Verified] Held date-count request: mobile renders 30 dates with zero counts. Desktop briefly says NO GAMES IN THIS MONTH before actual dates arrive.

Source at candidate 3058478: game-slate-machine.ts:148,168,237,376; games/page.tsx:484,512

Before

April 12 · 0 games
Request still pending

Proposed after

Loading game dates…
Counts appear after the response

Implementation: Represent calendar request resolution independently of the selected slate. Show a loading message/placeholder and withhold counts until resolved. A genuine empty month and zero-game day remain valid outcomes.

Completion evidence: Hold and release date counts, valid empty response, failures/retry, restored URL and rapid season changes. Preserve generation/cancellation rules. This needs lifecycle review if implemented.

F4 · MEDIUM · UNIMPLEMENTED

Keep Analysis identifiable while loading

[Verified] An eight-skeleton initial state has no h1 and no live loading message. Axe tests wait for h1, so they miss this state.

Source at candidate 3058478: analysis-content.tsx:634,978

Before


No page identity or announced loading state

Proposed after

Model Results
Loading historical results…
One status announcement

Implementation: Keep the Model Results heading and context outside the data-loading branch. Announce one concise status; mark decorative skeletons hidden and the changing data region busy.

Completion evidence: Hold the analysis response; verify page heading/loading status, then success/error. No per-skeleton announcement or repeated live announcements.

F5 · MEDIUM · UNIMPLEMENTED

Let enlarged text wrap in Home and Games

[Verified] Computed font sizes and line heights doubled at 390px: Home page width 407px (+17); Games 424px (+34). This is a text-size stress test, not actual browser zoom.

Source at candidate 3058478: home.module.css:41,45,47; games/page.tsx:637; game-slate-refresh-notice.tsx:12

Before

MATCHUPS · 15 GAMES   Refresh view
Fixed one-line arrangement

Proposed after

MATCHUPS · 15 GAMESRefresh view
Content grows vertically

Implementation: Use minmax(0,1fr)/min-width:0 where grid min-content grows the page; allow schedule-value lines to wrap. Let the Games heading and Refresh action wrap to another line, retaining its 44px target. Do not hide overflow.

Completion evidence: 390/320px normal and enlarged text, long labels, all Refresh states; actual browser 200% zoom/text resizing before closing the issue. Keep scores, units and source figures unchanged.

F6 · LOW · UNIMPLEMENTED

Protect the Calendar label at the narrowest width

[Verified] 320px: text extends 19.484px beyond its button and 2.484px beyond the card. Ancestors have visible overflow; the text is not clipped.

Source at candidate 3058478: games/page.tsx:422,438; season-selector.tsx

Before

2025-26 ▾CALENDAR

Proposed after

2025-26 ▾CALENDAR

Implementation: Allow the local Season/Calendar row to wrap. Keep Calendar at its intrinsic width; constrain the local season control to available space. Preserve the shared selector on other pages.

Completion evidence: Measure text inside button/card at 320/375/390px and enlarged text, with the calendar open and closed; preserve Enter, selected dates and focus return.

F7 · LOW · UNIMPLEMENTED

Enlarge game-dialog touch targets

[Verified] Close is 32×32px; recent-game rows are 26px high. This misses the project’s 44px comfort goal, not automatically WCAG 2.2 AA.

Source at candidate 3058478: explore-game-detail-modal.tsx

Before

32px Close / 26px row

Implementation: Use a 44px button hit area around the small Close icon; make recent-game buttons at least 44px high. Keep the existing scrollable dialog and visible content intact.

Completion evidence: Measure every relevant dialog target; phone portrait/landscape; scroll reachability, focus outline and keyboard drill/back.

F8 · OPTIONAL · UNIMPLEMENTED

Offer a native keyboard threshold shortcut

[Verified] ArrowRight exposes chart values; Enter/Space does not drill. The Rest advantage select below already provides an accessible alternative.

Source at candidate 3058478: analysis-content.tsx:1131

F9 · OPTIONAL · UNIMPLEMENTED

Make Model Results filters shareable

[Verified] Selecting RA ≥ 3 leaves /analysis unchanged; reload returns to All. The hook owns reducer state without URL synchronization.

Source at candidate 3058478: useExploreGames.ts:40

/analysis
Reload loses the chosen filters

Proposed after

/analysis?season=2025-26&minRA=3&team=BOS

2 · First-time-user walkthrough

This was an analyst’s cognitive walkthrough in real Chrome at asserted 390px and 1440px, not a study with an unfamiliar NBA fan. The site’s intended question and caveats are clear; no broad visual redesign is recommended from this evidence.

Visitor questionAction actually exercisedOutcome
What is this?Read Home on phone and desktop.[Verified] Rest/travel/schedule purpose, Find a game action, historical venue baseline and causal limitation are visible.
Where are upcoming games?Phone Home → Find a game. Desktop header → Games.[Verified] 2026-27 and October 20 selected; three scheduled games. Boston at Detroit shows 3:00 PM ET. EVEN 0.0 is accompanied by a season-opener explanation.
Why does a row say that?Open Boston–Detroit details, then How this is calculated.[Verified] Details expand; methodology explains higher fatigue scores, the differential, exclusions and limitations. A model score is not presented as win probability.
Can I return to my game?Browser Back from methodology.[Verified] Games restores season/date. Desktop Season → 2025-26 → APR → April 12 reached completed finals and URL /games?season=2025-26&date=2026-04-12.
Where is the historical evidence?Phone bottom Explore → Model Results.[Verified] Question-based study cards lead to evidence; native filters work. RA ≥ 3 does not survive reload (F9).
Are there runtime warnings?Read captured Chrome console.[Verified] Six Recharts initial width/height −1 measurement warnings were observed over the walkthrough. Charts subsequently rendered. No missing chart or performance regression was established.

[Inferred] The highest-value remaining comprehension test is with a real newcomer: can they distinguish a rest gap from a win prediction, and interpret a historical rate relative to home court? Do not add another FAQ, onboarding tour or chart animation without that evidence.

Physical iPhone check you already planned

Use the candidate preview when available. Open Games, change season/date, open and close Calendar, expand a matchup, and use all four bottom tabs. Repeat in portrait/landscape and with larger text. Confirm the final row/footer is reachable and the keyboard never hides a focused input. If you use VoiceOver, navigate headings/controls, open a dialog, dismiss it and note where spoken focus returns. Record the route, orientation/text setting and expected versus actual result for any issue.

Optional real-newcomer check

Ask one NBA fan unfamiliar with FullCourt to (1) find Boston at Detroit on October 20, (2) explain EVEN 0.0 without treating it as a win probability, and (3) find historical evidence and explain why home court is the comparison. Give no navigation hints initially. Record where they pause and their exact interpretation; this audit did not conduct that user study.

Evidence, rejected checks and scope

The five previously approved motion fixes remain in the exact candidate and had already passed their own 98 targeted browser checks, 20 motion cases, 1,148 unit tests and lint/typecheck/build/audit/docs gates. Those results are recorded in the candidate’s verification record; they were not all rerun for this document-only audit.

This audit’s temporary script initially timed out on networkidle and encountered an Axe page/context setup error. Corrected explicit readiness gates and explicit overlay contexts completed; the raw errors were preserved. The Calendar transition-time contrast warning was rejected after a settled recheck. A source lookup for a guessed useUpcomingGames.ts path failed; file discovery corrected the lookup and no claim depends on that missing path.

Raw evidence: /tmp/fullcourt-a11y-2026-10-14 — existing-suite.log, geometry.json, overlays.json, states.json, calendar-settled-axe.json, calendar320-boundary.json and text200-offenders.json. Selected screenshot evidence is embedded here. Application source, tests, dependencies, model, schema and production data were unchanged.

HTML structure, anchors, counts, embedded assets and source evidence were checked statically. The report itself was not visually previewed: the earlier report file navigation was blocked by browser security policy, and no alternate serving/browser workaround was attempted. Physical device, spoken accessibility, native zoom, candidate preview, exact production commit and deployed source maps remain explicit gaps.
